member.name: T:System.Windows.RuntimeHost.HostAppDomainManager
member.summary: The application domain manager the Silverlight host installs for the application's domain. It answers security checks and isolated-storage management requests from the native host. Applications do not create or call it.
member.remarks: On Xbox 360 the isolated-storage management callbacks are not implemented: they return E_NOTIMPL (0x80004001) and report empty values.

member.name: M:System.Windows.RuntimeHost.HostAppDomainManager.GetIsolatedStorageEnabled(System.Boolean@)
member.summary: Host callback that reports whether isolated storage is enabled. Not implemented on this platform.

member.name: M:System.Windows.RuntimeHost.HostAppDomainManager.SetIsolatedStorageEnabled(System.Boolean)
member.summary: Host callback that turns isolated storage on or off. Not implemented on this platform; the setting is ignored.

member.name: M:System.Windows.RuntimeHost.HostAppDomainManager.GetIsolatedStoreCount(System.Int32@)
member.summary: Host callback that reports how many sites have isolated stores. Not implemented on this platform.

member.name: M:System.Windows.RuntimeHost.HostAppDomainManager.GetIsolatedStoreInfo(System.Int32,System.Int32,System.Text.StringBuilder,System.Double@,System.Double@)
member.summary: Host callback that describes one site's isolated store. Not implemented on this platform.
member.param: The zero-based index of the store (ignored).
A buffer for the site URL; left unchanged.

member.name: M:System.Windows.RuntimeHost.HostAppDomainManager.DeleteIsolatedStore(System.String)
member.summary: Host callback that deletes a site's isolated store. Not implemented on this platform; nothing is deleted.
member.param: The site whose store would be deleted (ignored).

member.name: M:System.Windows.RuntimeHost.HostAppDomainManager.CheckSecuritySettings(System.Security.SecurityState)
member.summary: Called by the runtime to approve a security-sensitive operation.
member.returns: For socket checks, when the socket state asks for a new security manager to be created; otherwise , after recording the application's origin URL as the origin host for socket policy checks. All other checks return .
